```{r}
ck_dir <- "D:/RLibrary"
if (dir.exists(ck_dir)) .libPaths(c(ck_dir, .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(biblioIntegrator))
pbs <- python_backend_status()
cat("disponivel:", pbs$available, "| versao:", pbs$version, "| python:", pbs$python, "\n")
```

```{r}
x <- as_biblio_project(example_biblio())
g <- ifelse(x$works$year < 2022, "early", "late")
cmpB <- tryCatch(biblium_compare_groups(x, g, permutations = 99, seed = 7),
                 error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
if (inherits(cmpB, "biblio_group_comparison")) {
  cat("BIBLIUM OK -> chi:", cmpB$chi_square, " p:", cmpB$p_value, " V:", cmpB$cramers_v, "\n")
} else cat("BIBLIUM FALHOU:", cmpB, "\n")
```
